value.name: The Bulwark
value.descriptionTemplate: A character built to stand between danger and everyone else, absorbing what others can't.
value.flavorTemplate: {name} isn't the flashiest option, but it's the one people want standing next to them.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description: Can plant themselves in a spot and become noticeably harder to move or bypass.

features.name: Draw the Eye
features.description: Good at making themselves the obvious target, on purpose.

features.name: Shrug It Off
features.description: Recovers from setbacks faster than most, physically or otherwise.

value.name: The Quickblade
value.descriptionTemplate: A character built around speed and precision over raw force.
value.flavorTemplate: {name} would rather end a fight in the first three seconds than the last three.

features.name: First Strike
features.description: Tends to act before anyone else has quite caught up.

features.name: Read the Room
features.description: Picks up on small tells others miss -- a flinch, a shift in weight, a held breath.

features.name: Precision Over Power
features.description: Can turn a small opening into a decisive one.

value.name: The Wayfinder
value.descriptionTemplate: A character defined by knowing where to go and what's actually there.
value.flavorTemplate: {name} has been more places than they usually admit to.

features.name: Never Quite Lost
features.description: Has an uncanny sense for direction and terrain, even somewhere new.

features.name: Contingency
features.description: Tends to have a backup plan already half-formed before it's needed.

features.name: Knows a Guy
features.description: Seems to have a useful contact wherever they end up.

value.name: The Voice
value.descriptionTemplate: A character who gets what they need through words, presence, and timing rather than force.
value.flavorTemplate: {name} has talked their way out of more trouble than most people talk their way into.

features.name: Command Attention
features.description: Has a way of making a room listen, whether it wants to or not.

features.name: Read Intentions
features.description: Good at telling when someone's lying, or at least when they're nervous.

features.name: Rally
features.description: Can steady a group that's starting to fall apart.

value.name: The Tinker
value.descriptionTemplate: A character who solves problems by building, fixing, or repurposing something clever.
value.flavorTemplate: {name} has never met a broken thing they didn't want to take apart.

features.name: Field Repair
features.description: Can patch, jury-rig, or improvise a fix in a pinch.

features.name: Waste Not
features.description: Gets more out of limited materials than seems reasonable.

features.name: Built for This
features.description: Carries or can rig up a tool for almost any situation, given a little time.

value.name: The Outcast
value.descriptionTemplate: A character shaped by having lived outside whatever counts as normal in this world.
value.flavorTemplate: {name} learned to survive on terms nobody else would agree to.

features.name: Hard-Won Instincts
features.description: Trusts their gut about danger, and their gut is usually right.

features.name: Nothing Left to Prove
features.description: Doesn't rattle easily -- they've already survived worse.

features.name: Own Rules
features.description: Solves problems in ways that wouldn't occur to someone with a more conventional upbringing.

designNotes.value: Procedurally rolled, narrative-first (this world has no leveling/numeric class system) -- worth a manual polish pass.
